## Summary

One-off full-tree sync of **vercel/vercel-internal** `main` onto public
**vercel/vercel**.

| | SHA |
| --- | --- |
| Internal `main` | `21610535bccb3c000b9a361fb07bc24856481ab3`
(2026-10-27) |
| Public `main` base | `c628be7835e03a965b93e9cf9e2bd5ac2acbf5eb` (last
public sync PR #17595 from internal `1df8ab80f226`) |
| Squash commit on this branch |
`e33d0d24fab9ed5c07155ea3fe8b195b503f31fb` (SSH-signed) |

Internal range: `1df8ab80f226..21610535bccb` (663 commits).

**This is a one-off human sync.** Tom's planned automation
(`workflow_dispatch`, `.syncignore`, gh-sts, author Slack sign-off) was
never built. There is still no `sync-to-public` workflow on
vercel-internal. Jeff See requested this full sync as the human gate.

## Exclusions

`.syncignore` does not exist on internal, so the fallback exclusions
were applied:

- **`.github/`** — public workflows/CI left exactly as they are (not
overwritten with internal)
- **`.syncignore`** — absent; not created on public
- **`.sync-state.json`** — absent; not written on public
- **`users/`** — personal contributor folders (not on public `main`;
AGENTS.md bookkeeping)
- **PR-binaries API glue** (same as #17595): `api/pr-binaries-token.ts`,
`api/prune-pr-binaries.ts`, `api/_lib/util/pr-binary-upload.ts`,
`utils/pr-binary-upload.test.js`, plus the `/pr-binaries` rewrite and
`functions` block stripped from `vercel.json`

Deletions propagated: public working tree (except excluded paths) was
replaced with the filtered internal tree, then committed as one squash.

`github.com/vercel/vercel-internal` URLs were rewritten to
`github.com/vercel/vercel` in the public clone (KMS typedoc + one test
file). Bare `vercel/vercel-internal` strings in CI helpers/tests were
**not** rewritten (see scan).

## Diffstat

`git diff --shortstat origin/main...HEAD` (`gh pr diff` has no `--stat`
flag):

**3614 files changed, 351554 insertions(+), 64475 deletions(-)**

## ⚠️ Merger: squash with `[skip ci]`

Public `release.yml` still runs **on push to main**. This tree still has
**pending changesets** (11 changeset markdown files). Squash-merging
without `[skip ci]` will make the public Release workflow try to publish
from the public repo.

**Exact squash-merge subject:**

```
chore: sync from internal (21610535bccb) [skip ci]
```

Do **not** use `gh pr merge --admin`. Do not merge this PR from this
agent.

## Authors / sign-off

Jeff See requested this full sync as the human gate. Slack per-author
sign-off was **not** run (automation does not exist).

93 unique human authors in the internal range (bots filtered:
github-actions, vercel\[bot\], Cursor Agent, Copilot-class, Anthropic,
OpenCode, dependabot-class, agent-factory, etc.). The squash commit
lists 55 unique `vercel.com` / `users.noreply.github.com` authors as
`Co-authored-by`. The full 93 are in a follow-up comment.

Notable: Jeff See, Thomas Knickman, Nick Schrock, Mehul Kar, Joe Haddad,
Nathan Rajlich, Malte Ubl, and many others.

## Pre-PR scan

**No definite secrets found. PR opened.**

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| AWS keys (`AKIA`/`ASIA`) | none |
| PEM / private keys | none |
| `ghp_` / `github_pat_` | none |
| Real `npm_` tokens | none |
| `VERCEL_TOKEN` / `NPM_TOKEN` assignments | only test fixtures
(`cli-auth-token`) |
| `credentials.json` / `.env` dumps | none added;
`examples/blitzjs/.env*` **deleted** (example removed internally) |
| `github.com/vercel/vercel-internal` | none remaining after rewrite |

### Ambiguous / review before merge

Jeff should eyeball these; they are not secrets but they look internal:

1. **Bare `vercel/vercel-internal` strings** (13 files) — CI
helpers/tests that assert the internal repo name, e.g.
`utils/comment-cli-tarball.js` (gates on `pull.base.repo.full_name ===
'vercel/vercel-internal'`), `utils/check-npm-packages-exist.mjs`,
`packages/vc-native/scripts/publish-packages.mjs`,
`packages/cli/scripts/testserver/create-testserver.mjs`, plus several
`utils/*.test.js`. Left as-is so tests keep their original assertions;
they point the public tree at the private repo name.
2. **`.vc/automations/`** — Agent Factory workflows that were not on
public `main` (includes personal `scubbo-greeting` / `melkey-label`).
3. **`.release-candidate.json` / `.release-plan.json`** — generated
internal release state (GitHub Actions run id, package version plan).
4. **`.vercel.ci.json`** — Vercel CI bootstrap for this repo
(`utils/vercel-ci-install.sh`).
5. **`vercel.json` `/tarballs/*.tgz` header** — new vs public `main`;
content-type only, no blob rewrite.
6. **Fake Slack tokens in tests** — `xoxp-default`, `xoxp-unscoped`,
`xoxb-1` in `packages/cli/test/unit/commands/connex/token.test.ts`.
7. **`https://internal.corp/v1` in CLI tests** — negative fixtures
asserting those URLs are stripped from generated agent config.
8. **`host.docker.internal`** — Docker hostname in sandbox/dev tests,
not corp DNS.

## Test plan

- [ ] Confirm public `.github/` is unchanged vs `main` (`git diff
main...HEAD -- .github` empty)
- [ ] Confirm `users/`, `api/pr-binaries-token.ts`,
`api/prune-pr-binaries.ts` are absent
- [ ] Confirm `vercel.json` has `/install` and does **not** have
`/pr-binaries`
- [ ] Spot-check scan callouts above
- [ ] Squash-merge with `[skip ci]` in the subject only after review
